Markup-fidelity fixture for the DASHBOARD GAUGE component (pa-gauge) — a top semi-circle ring gauge drawn purely with CSS (a conic-gradient on the ::before pseudo masked into a donut). See ../README.md and progress.json / data-bar.json for the CLOSEST model (a data-driven inline style carries the geometry value; a primary-default-no-class variant guard). Shape:
TEXT
MINLABELMAX
. The ring fill is NOT an SVG arc or a JS needle — it is a single inline CSS custom property style="--value: N" (unitless 0-100; the SCSS multiplies by 1.8deg). Nothing is drawn by JS at runtime, so there are no cssStateElements: the whole gauge is SSR-complete.

propsVocabulary.value: gauge value 0-100 (NO % suffix) — sets the inline style --value: N on the block; the SCSS converts it to degrees (N * 1.8deg) on the conic-gradient. Data-driven geometry, structural, no class.
propsVocabulary.valueText: text shown inside the donut in pa-gauge__value (e.g. "72%", "85°"). Distinct from value: value drives the arc geometry, valueText is the human-readable display string.
propsVocabulary.label: gauge caption (CPU / Memory / Temp …) rendered below the baseline in pa-gauge__label, centred between the min/max endpoints. Omitted when falsy.
propsVocabulary.min: left endpoint label in pa-gauge__min (default conceptually "0").
propsVocabulary.max: right endpoint label in pa-gauge__max (default conceptually "100").
propsVocabulary.variant: colour variant (success|warning|danger|info) — overrides only --pa-gauge-fill. primary is the BASE fill (var(--pc-accent)) and emits NO modifier class.
propsVocabulary.zones: boolean — multi-zone gauge (pa-gauge--zones): replaces the single-colour arc with a fixed green/yellow/red band gradient. Independent of variant (zones wins the fill).
propsVocabulary.size: optional CSS length override for --pa-gauge-size (default upstream 12rem). Appended to the inline style after --value. Structural, no class.

goldenConventions: Goldens encode the core SCSS contract (_data-viz.scss §4) as refined by the component docstrings, NOT the stale demo markup. TWO deliberate deviations from demo/views/data-visualization.mustache: (1) the demo nests pa-gauge__label INSIDE pa-gauge__inner, but the SCSS comment is explicit that the label 'moved out to the row below (alongside __min / __max)' and __inner 'gets the whole interior to itself' — so the blessed shape puts __label as a SIBLING after __inner, in natural left-to-right reading order __min · __label · __max. (2) the demo wraps each gauge in a layout <div class="text-center"> — that is a demo grid cell, NOT part of pa-gauge, so the golden is the bare pa-gauge block. The arc fill is a data-driven inline CSS variable style="--value: {value}" (unitless, no %; the SCSS applies *1.8deg). An optional --pa-gauge-size follows in the same style when size is set. primary is the DEFAULT variant and emits NO pa-gauge--primary class (no such class exists in main.css). Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (grep '\.pa-gauge(--|__)'). `produces: null` = structural/native/inline-style (no pa-gauge modifier). variant EXCLUDES 'primary' — the base fill IS the accent, there is no pa-gauge--primary in the CSS. The arc value and the size override are data-driven INLINE STYLES (--value / --pa-gauge-size), not classes, matching the progress/data-bar inline-style precedent.

value.note: structural — inline style --value: N on the block (unitless 0-100, SCSS *1.8deg); no class. nativeType number in both wrappers.

valueText.note: display text inside the donut; a <span class="pa-gauge__value">. Always present in the blessed shape.

label.note: caption below the baseline; a <span class="pa-gauge__label">. Omitted when falsy.

size.note: structural — optional inline style --pa-gauge-size: <len> appended after --value; no class

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature
